description: Use this when the user wants to print addresses on envelopes ("print envelopes with addresses", "print envelopes from excel", "#10 envelope template", "a7 envelope template", "address wedding invitation envelopes", "print address on envelope"). First convert any pasted text or image of addresses into recipients objects (name, address1, address2, city, state, zip, country). Makes a PDF with one page per envelope at the real envelope size (#10 default, #9, #6 3/4, Monarch, A2, A6, A7, A9, 6x9, 9x12, 10x13, DL, C6, C5, C4 or custom), the return address in the top-left corner and the delivery address inside the USPS read area, in the destination country's line order. Each address gets an envelope; problems (missing ZIP, unknown state, wrapped lines) are listed. Also a CSV. Does not buy postage, print stamps or barcodes, verify addresses, or print label sheets.

address1.description: Street address, e.g. 123 Main St. A whole one-line US address is split automatically.

address2.description: Apartment, suite or unit, e.g. Apt 4B.

company.description: Company or organization line, e.g. Acme Corp.

country.description: Country, e.g. Canada or DE. Leave empty for addresses in your own country.

lines.description: The address as printed lines instead of fields, e.g. ["Jane Smith", "123 Main St", "Springfield, IL 62704"].

name.description: Recipient name, e.g. Jane Smith or Mr. and Mrs. Garcia.

state.description: State, province or region, e.g. IL, Ontario or Bavaria.

zip.description: ZIP or postal code, e.g. 62704, M5V 2T6 or 10115.

bold_name.description: Print the recipient's name in bold, e.g. true. Default false.

columns.description: Column mapping when headings are unusual, field to heading, e.g. {"name":"Guest","address1":"Mailing Street","zip":"Postcode"}.

envelope_size.description: Envelope size: 10, 9, 6-3/4, monarch, a2, a6, a7, a9, 6x9, 9x12, 10x13, dl, c6, c5, c4 or a custom size like "5.5 x 8.5 in" or "114 x 229 mm". Synonyms work: "business" = 10, "5x7" or "invitation" = a7, "rsvp" = a2. Default 10.

feed.description: With paper letter or a4: where the envelope sits in the tray, center (default), left or right.

file.description: Optional uploaded address list: CSV, TSV or Excel .xlsx with a header row (Name, Address, City, State, ZIP, Country), e.g. wedding guests.xlsx. Google Contacts, Outlook, Etsy and Shopify exports work.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

font_size.description: Address text size in points, 8 to 24, e.g. 12. Default 12 (11 on narrow envelopes). Long lines shrink to fit and wrap; nothing is cut off.

height.description: Custom envelope height with width, e.g. 4.125 or "162 mm".

home_country.description: Country you mail from; the country line is printed only for other countries, e.g. "UK". Default: the return address's country, else United States.

include_home_country.description: Also print the country line for addresses in your own country when a country is given. Default false.

outline.description: Draw the envelope edge on every page (for checking on plain paper). Default false.

paper.description: envelope (default: each PDF page is the envelope size) or letter / a4 (the envelope is drawn turned on a full sheet, for printers that cannot take a custom size).
